rules.title: Boston Rental Assistance and Fair Housing Screening Protections
rules.requirement: Property owners in Boston cannot discriminate against tenants or housing applicants based on rental assistance (such as Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers, and veterans vouchers) or other protected characteristics.

coverage.summary: Applies to renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing in the City of Boston.

rules.quoted_span: In the City of Boston, it’s illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing. You can’t discriminate someone based on their: Race Color Religion Disability National Origin Ancestry Sex Gender Identity Gender Expression Age Sexual Orientation Marital Status Rental Assistance * Family Status ** Military Status * For example renters using Section 8 voucher
